A tree is like a living, breathing being, adapting to its surroundings, growing and changing with the seasons.

My sister and I loved to climb on its branches, using it as a makeshift jungle gym. Our parents would caution us, warning us not to overexert ourselves, but we were invincible, convinced that the tree would always hold our weight. As we grew older, the tree grew with us, its branches stretching higher and higher, a steadfast companion to our ever-changing lives.
